crossRefs.note: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.
Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face, that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that…
which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles…
that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus…
being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because…
For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was…
For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven…
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

translations.web: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
translations.bsb: On this mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;
translations.kjv: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
translations.asv: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering that covereth all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
